message.content:
Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS atau membantu Anda memesan produk, kami perlu memastikan akun Anda terautentikasi terlebih dahulu.  

Apakah Anda sudah memiliki akun? Jika ya, silakan berikan nama pengguna (username) dan kata sandi Anda (atau beri tahu kami jika Anda ingin membuat akun baru).  

Jika Anda tidak ingin masuk sekarang, beri tahu kami produk apa yang Anda cari, dan kami akan mencoba membantu sebaik mungkin!

The system has a function for user authentication. But the user didn't provide credentials. We might need to ask for login. But maybe we can respond: "Maaf, ukuran XS tidak tersedia" or ask for more info. We can ask if they want to place an order or check inventory. We can also ask for username/password to authenticate. The function is for authentication. We can ask them to login. Probably we should ask for credentials. Let's respond politely asking for login.
